comment: Golden classification table for the I-CONFLUENCE conformance test. Each entry asserts that an operation with the documented (name, side_effects, idempotency_class) tuple SHALL classify as the named coordination_class per the rubric in docs/architecture/i_confluence_classification.md. Filed under flywheel_connectors-angoc.11.1.

cases.name: list_charges
cases.rationale: List operation, side-effect-free; matches the ^(get|list|...) read-name pattern

cases.name: create_charge
cases.rationale: Mutating + idempotency_class=strict (Stripe idempotency-key style) — quorum gives durability without per-resource fencing

cases.name: send_message
cases.rationale: Mutating chat send — quorum prevents lost messages on peer failure

cases.name: refund_charge
cases.rationale: Per-resource serialization required (the same charge cannot be refunded twice concurrently); HRW lease on (connector_id, charge_id) ensures exclusive writer

cases.name: update_subscription
cases.rationale: Per-subscription serialization; concurrent updates fence on lease epoch

cases.name: delete_user
cases.rationale: Per-user exclusive write; cannot race a concurrent re-create

invalid_combinations.name: list_charges
invalid_combinations.rationale: The rubric's primary safety gate — i_confluent + side_effects=true is a misclassification

invalid_combinations.name: create_charge
invalid_combinations.rationale: Side-effect-free ops should be classified i_confluent, not requires_quorum (over-strict; wastes quorum cost)

expected_e2e_throughput_ratio.rationale: Synthetic 50%-read workload; classified reads should be >=3x throughput of force-quorum
